entries.title: gh 'Resource not accessible by integration' means re-mint provision_vcs_auth with git_access push+pr
entries.summary: When gh or git reports 'Resource not accessible by integration', the GitHub App token lacks the needed access. Re-mint with provision_vcs_auth using git_access push+pr (push alone cannot create PRs or dispatch workflows) and repos as full owner/repo names.
entries.content: error_signature: "Resource not accessible by integration" (gh / GitHub API 403). Cause: the GitHub App installation token minted by provision_vcs_auth was granted too little access (e.g. git_access push or read). push cannot create PRs or dispatch workflows. Fix: re-run provision_vcs_auth (github-app) with git_access: "push+pr" and repos passed as full owner/repo names (e.g. Apra-Labs/apra-fleet). Members provisioned only by sprint preflight have no stored access level and may fail with deploy_failed until re-minted. Evidence: GIT_ACCESS_DESCRIPTION and git_access enum (read, push, push+pr, admin, issues, full) in src/tools/provision-vcs-auth.ts.
